name: runalith-agent-orchestrator
description: Local-first durable agent workflow orchestration with immutable plans, versioned policies, typed evidence, and approval-gated execution.
long_description: Runalith is a local-first MCP workflow runtime. It persists workflow state in SQLite, compiles explicitly approved proposals into immutable plans, schedules dependency-aware specialist tasks, executes approved deterministic commands locally, validates typed artifacts and provenance, and records recovery and audit events. The MCPB is a standard package container for compatible clients; Runalith does not provide a hosted model service or remote execution fleet.

tools.name: workflow_coordinator_role
tools.description: Read the immutable built-in System Workflow Coordinator role used by the host assistant. It is not a custom role and cannot be created or modified through custom-role tools.

tools.name: workflow_coordinator_step
tools.description: Primary high-level workflow lifecycle tool. Dispatches only approved runs, prepares tasks, advances approved deterministic local steps, returns the next specialist contract, and submits task results or synthesis without bypassing approval/evidence gates.

tools.name: orchestrator_health
tools.description: Check local plugin and SQLite state; does not probe remote services.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_graph_search
tools.description: Run bounded, read-only Adaptive Goal Graph nominal-success beam search and project complete candidates into review-only Plan Graph drafts. Returns deterministic expansion/pruning/lineage audit, explicit relation semantics, unverified evidence ledger, and unknown metrics as null. Candidate execution gates remain disabled.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_phase2_shadow_search
tools.description: Opt-in source-only Phase 2 learned-discriminator search; set AGG_PHASE2_SHADOW_TOOL_ENABLED=1 to expose it in tools/list. Uses a caller-supplied self-hash-validated model and returns non-persisted review-only Plan Graph shadow drafts. Model hash is not trusted provenance; metrics are not independently recomputed without examples. Never persists, approves, dispatches, or executes.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_phase3_mcts_shadow_search
tools.description: Opt-in source-only Phase 3 bounded UCT/MCTS over Idea Graph nominal transitions, guided by a caller-supplied Phase 2 discriminator. Set AGG_PHASE3_MCTS_TOOL_ENABLED=1 only for authorized shadow testing. Results remain non-persisted, unverified, non-exhaustive and non-executable; model self-hash is not trusted provenance.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_recovery_resolve
tools.description: Read-only, outcome-aware recovery recommendation for explicit recovers_to conditions. Requires the observed outcome and declared available prerequisite/evidence nodes; the result is not independently evidence-verified and never authorizes execution.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_node_save
tools.description: Append or revise a shared Idea Graph node with stable cross-goal identity, immutable revisions, canonical content/evidence hash, required provenance and expected-revision compare-and-swap. Saved knowledge remains unverified.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_capture_workflow_outcome
tools.description: Opt-in source-only local testing tool. Capture bounded metadata from a terminal local workflow as an unverified Idea Graph experiment with an optional caller-authored lesson; no result bodies, verification, authorization, or dispatch.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_edge_add
tools.description: Append a typed, provenance-bound Idea Graph relation. recovers_to requires explicit condition and expected-outcome contracts, and does not grant execution authority.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_search
tools.description: Search the shared append-only Idea Graph across goals and inspect reused concept memberships. Unverified knowledge is discoverable for review but unusable for planning without an independent verifier.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_snapshot_get
tools.description: Read a canonical persisted Goal/Idea Graph snapshot, all current and historical revisions, membership and edge provenance, and current evidence-integrity results. A trusted external signature is required before the snapshot is planning-usable.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_trust_configuration_status
tools.description: Read-only for workflow, graph and approval state; records an observed valid trust configuration version/fingerprint in a separate append-only local ledger to prevent downgrade. Reports config version/fingerprint, public-root fingerprints, validity/revocation and administrator change metadata without exposing PEMs. Flags shared provider IDs or roots across source-verifier and reviewer domains. Configure through the host-supported administrator environment mechanism, never through MCP arguments.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_snapshot_attest
tools.description: Verify and persist an external Ed25519 Goal/Idea Graph attestation over the exact snapshot and current durable evidence manifest; caller-supplied hashes cannot self-promote source claims or independence.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_graph_search
tools.description: Search a current verifier-attested persisted Goal/Idea Graph and project review-only Plan Graph drafts, requiring exact snapshot identity and revalidated evidence lineage.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_node_get
tools.description: Read the current or exact immutable Idea Graph node revision, including cross-goal memberships, evidence refs, content hash, provenance hash, and unverified status.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_node_history
tools.description: Read append-only revision history for a shared Idea Graph node; historical content/evidence refs/hashes are preserved and remain unverified.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_knowledge_recovery_resolve
tools.description: Read-only outcome-aware recovery check for a persisted Idea Graph recovers_to edge. Requires a matching observed outcome and active durable artifact evidence whose hash, producer, result and completion lineage verifies and whose structured content declares the same outcome. Recovery routes remain review-only and cannot be executed or dispatched.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_plan_compatibility_check
tools.description: Read-only compatibility assessment for an unverified AGG Plan Graph draft against a compiled supported workflow template using explicit step-to-task bindings. Reports dependency/template blockers only; never creates a workflow proposal, persists a plan, approves, authorizes, dispatches, or executes.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_plan_proposal_create
tools.description: Create a review-only workflow proposal from a freshly revalidated AGG candidate using explicit step-to-task bindings. Recomputes the candidate and compatibility in memory, pins draft/mapping hashes into the success contract and stores the exact draft snapshot in the proposal event. Creates a PROPOSED workflow only; it does not pre-approve, pin an immutable execution plan, dispatch, or execute. Run workflow_preflight and inspect the proposal before separately approving.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_plan_proposal_get
tools.description: Read back and revalidate the exact AGG proposal snapshot (source graph, candidate-derived Plan Graph draft, draft/mapping hashes, and structural template compatibility). Read-only; it does not alter workflow state, approve, dispatch, or execute.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_execution_readiness_check
tools.description: Read-only assessment of explicit AGG action-to-task mappings against immutable role capability/input/output artifact contracts, compiled dependency ancestry, and durable artifact/evidence lineage. It distinguishes contract readiness from source-evidence readiness and never creates an Execution Graph or executable contract, grants permissions, approves, dispatches, or executes.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_execution_graph_proposal_create
tools.description: Create a persisted, review-only Execution Graph proposal from a stored Plan Graph proposal after revalidating its candidate, exact draft/bindings, role/capability contracts, DAG ancestry, active durable artifact/event lineage, producer completion, schema versions and hashes. Requires readiness to pass; otherwise returns stable blockers without writing a job. A successful result creates only a PROPOSED standard-engineering review wrapper, never executable contracts, task rows, approval, dispatch or execution.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_execution_graph_proposal_get
tools.description: Read back and revalidate a stored Execution Graph proposal against its source Plan Graph proposal and current durable artifact evidence. Reports stale hashes, changed workflow contracts or invalidated evidence as stable blockers. Read-only; never pins plans, approves, dispatches or executes.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_execution_plan_candidate_create
tools.description: Validate and persist a review-only execution-plan candidate through the existing compiler and validator. A versioned semantic policy enforces role/capability, canonical operation, exactly bound target, output artifact type, complete role completion criteria, canonical description, and proof/hash. Caller-supplied reviewerId is never authenticated identity: approval, dispatch and task preparation require a valid, unexpired, replay-free provider-signed Ed25519 attestation under the configured trust root, bound to the exact candidate, semantic fingerprint, role-contract version and immutable-plan hash. Without that provider integration the identity blocker remains fail-closed. Candidate creation only stores one bounded event; it never approves, pins plans, creates tasks, dispatches, authorizes execution, or synthesizes commands/arguments.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_execution_plan_candidate_get
tools.description: Rebuild and revalidate the persisted execution-plan candidate and its original reviewed-action-intent input from the current Execution Graph proposal, source evidence, typed artifact bindings, role/artifact contracts, dependency ancestry, compiler output, validator and normal preflight hash. Reports tampering/staleness as stable blockers; does not refresh snapshots, pin plans, approve, create tasks or dispatch.

tools.name: adaptive_goal_sandbox_action_execute
tools.description: Experimental test-only executor for one hard-coded, no-network AGG fixture action. Requires provider-signed reviewer identity, exact current candidate/intent and immutable approved plan, dispatch, completed prerequisites, and durable evidence lineage. Refuses production mode, stale/tampered inputs, unsupported actions and replay; does not accept caller-supplied commands or paths, and never grants production execution authority.

tools.name: workflow_catalog
tools.description: List supported local workflow templates, including hybrid-engineering for pinned role/Skill overlays and deterministic Batch Execution.

tools.name: workflow_recommend_resources
tools.description: Proactively match task intent against saved workflows, custom roles, skills and policy packs. Read-only discovery; reuse remains subject to immutable contract compatibility and approval gates.

tools.name: workflow_policy_catalog
tools.description: List the closed JSON policy-rule types and exact runtime enforcement points supported by this plugin.

tools.name: workflow_policy_create
tools.description: Create immutable version 1 of a reusable workflow policy pack using only supported closed JSON predicates.

tools.name: workflow_policy_list
tools.description: List reusable workflow policy packs, optionally including all immutable versions.

tools.name: workflow_policy_get
tools.description: Read a policy pack at its latest or exact immutable version and inspect workflow attachments.

tools.name: workflow_policy_update
tools.description: Create the next immutable version of an existing policy pack; previous versions and plans remain unchanged.

tools.name: workflow_policy_validate
tools.description: Validate a policy pack definition without storing it, including closed schemas and rule conflicts.

tools.name: workflow_policy_attach
tools.description: Attach an exact policy version to an unapproved workflow proposal and pin it into the immutable approved plan.

tools.name: workflow_create
tools.description: Create a local proposal with optional pinned role profiles, closed success predicates, and explicit workspace.write scopes for built-in standard-engineering v3+ engineer/writer tasks. Infeasible operation/scope contracts fail before persistence; approval and execution remain separate.

tools.name: workflow_preflight
tools.description: Read-only feasibility check of workflow version, permissions, scoped workspace-write paths, and immutable-plan consistency before approval.

tools.name: workflow_list
tools.description: List active workflows from local SQLite.

tools.name: workflow_get
tools.description: Inspect workflow plan, tasks, approvals, and evidence metadata.

tools.name: workflow_liveness_diagnostics
tools.description: Read-only active-job liveness diagnostics using durable activity timestamps and task-lease heartbeat/expiry. Flags stale candidates without mutating state, retrying, or dispatching work.

tools.name: workflow_approve
tools.description: Explicitly approve a proposal after feasibility checks and compile its immutable plan.

tools.name: workflow_write_files
tools.description: Apply hash-fenced file changes only inside the current built-in engineer/writer task's approved standard-engineering v3+ path scope; emits durable per-file receipts and reports partial writes.

tools.name: workflow_dispatch
tools.description: Start the approved workflow locally.

tools.name: workflow_prepare_tasks
tools.description: Create or recover planned child tasks.

tools.name: workflow_next_task
tools.description: Return the next dependency-ready task with typed predecessor evidence; hybrid-engineering batches all ready deterministic checks. Blocked means findings must be resolved before synthesis.

tools.name: workflow_diagnose
tools.description: Read-only diagnosis of a stuck local workflow: identifies failed/pending tasks, current reviewer findings, stale or missing typed artifacts, and safe next actions. Never mutates state or bypasses approval/success gates.

tools.name: workflow_request_rework
tools.description: Request a provenance-preserving specialist rework cycle for a blocked standard-engineering v2+ workflow after a completed reviewer decision. Invalidates affected active artifacts, creates linked role revision tasks, and preserves immutable plan and approval gates. Unsupported workflow IDs need a new proposal.

tools.name: workflow_request_reviewer_revision
tools.description: Request a provenance-preserving reviewer revision only when a standard-engineering v2+ accepted review is blocked solely by documented evidenceIssues; never approves synthesis or weakens the immutable success contract.

tools.name: workflow_complete_task
tools.description: Persist the actual result and typed artifact of a local specialist task.

tools.name: task_execute_local
tools.description: Execute an approved structured deterministic command locally.

tools.name: execute_batch
tools.description: Execute approved deterministic local tasks as a durable batch through the existing ExecutionManager; task commands and roles are derived from the immutable approved plan.

tools.name: workflow_complete_synthesis
tools.description: Independently evaluate declared JSON success predicates against the immutable plan, durable tasks, and provenance-validated artifacts before terminalization.

tools.name: workflow_events
tools.description: Read the durable workflow event history.

tools.name: workflow_artifacts
tools.description: List durable typed artifacts.

tools.name: workflow_e2e_run
tools.description: Advance approved workflows through safe deterministic tasks only.

tools.name: workflow_recovery_verify
tools.description: Verify durable workflow invariants and fresh-process SQLite readback.

tools.name: workflow_record_intervention
tools.description: Record manual interventions and proposed automation.

tools.name: workflow_interventions
tools.description: List recorded manual interventions.

tools.name: workflow_validate_artifact
tools.description: Validate typed artifact required fields and optional role matching.

tools.name: workflow_access_diagnostics
tools.description: Read-only diagnostics for trust/config errors; never bypasses trust policy.

tools.name: custom_role_create
tools.description: Create a validated, durable custom role definition. Does not enable execution.

tools.name: custom_role_update
tools.description: Create a new immutable version of a custom role definition.

tools.name: custom_role_get
tools.description: Read the latest or a specific version of a custom role.

tools.name: custom_role_list
tools.description: List custom roles and optionally their stored versions.

tools.name: custom_role_clone
tools.description: Clone an existing custom role into a new role ID.

tools.name: custom_workflow_create
tools.description: Create a validated custom workflow definition without executing it.

tools.name: custom_workflow_update
tools.description: Create a new immutable custom workflow definition version.

tools.name: custom_workflow_get
tools.description: Read a custom workflow definition version.

tools.name: custom_workflow_list
tools.description: List custom workflow definitions and versions.

tools.name: custom_workflow_clone
tools.description: Clone a custom workflow definition.

tools.name: custom_workflow_preview
tools.description: Create an immutable custom workflow plan preview with pinned role versions.

tools.name: custom_workflow_approve
tools.description: Approve a specific custom workflow plan preview before execution can be proposed.

tools.name: custom_workflow_run_create
tools.description: Create a proposal from an approved custom workflow plan with an optional goal and closed JSON success predicates; separate execution approval is required.

goal_idea_verifier_trust_config_json.title: Goal/Idea Graph verifier trust configuration (JSON)
goal_idea_verifier_trust_config_json.description: Optional host-managed trust config supplied and approved by your security administrator. Use the versioned goal_idea_verifier config with scope agg.goal_idea_graph.verify. Public Ed25519 keys only; never paste a private key. Leaving this blank keeps verified Goal/Idea Graph planning blocked.

action_intent_reviewer_trust_config_json.title: Action-intent reviewer trust configuration (JSON)
action_intent_reviewer_trust_config_json.description: Optional host-managed trust config supplied by your security administrator and approved by a separately administered reviewer authority. Use the versioned action_intent_reviewer config with scope agg.action_intent.review and public roots disjoint from the verifier roots. Public Ed25519 keys only; never paste a private key. Leaving this blank keeps trusted review and approval blocked.
